title: Gerber Gear ComplEAT Cutting Board Set - Cutting Board Kit with Polypropylene & Bamboo Cutting Boards - Features Paring Knife & Chef's Knife in Nesting Design
features: Cutting Board Set: The Gerber Gear ComplEAT cutting board kit has everything you need for easy campsite cooking
Durable Knife Set: It features corrosion-resistant German stainless-steel blades in a packable design for easy camp storage
Dual-Sided Chop Boards: Our camping cutting board set comes with a 9.6" x 15.6" bamboo cutting board and an 8.9" x 14.3" polypropylene cutting board with juice grooves
Secure & Organized: Each element nests within the other, including a chef's knife and paring knife, making travel simple and safe
About Gerber Gear: Since we made our start 85 years ago, we've been making blades and tools that have been companions on countless adventures
